overall_summary: Omar Haddad’s resume provides strong evidence of AI evaluation work involving versioned test collections, multidimensional scorecards, human-review processes, model-based rating validation, difficult-case design, regression checks, and release decisions. It also documents applied Python quality automation. The resume contains related but insufficient evidence for RAG, AI/ML/LLM fundamentals, and AI system design, while agentic AI and AI security require direct interview probing.
